limits: CSS syntax/comment equivalence covers formatting only; separately documented JavaScript owners change Upload target and Library loading behavior.
Font shorthand spelling is retained where whitespace changes parser token representation. One intact SVG data URL remains long; source bytes increase and no performance improvement is claimed.

Public viewport states enter fresh documents at selected widths. Each served/dated/restored three-frame comparison preserves its same DOM, stylesheet positions and pointer/focus/scroll identity; dynamically loaded CSS is awaited. No resize-transition equivalence is claimed.

Settled captures consistently disable animation/transition/caret painting. Ordered source syntax and normal integration checks retain motion scope; no exhaustive selector/viewport or animation-frame proof is claimed.
The original CSS tests retain their separate v2.18.11 baseline and are included in browser pass counts but excluded from the 95 new comparison total.
Tests use disposable APIs/generated technical EPUBs. No live upload/catalog/provider write, real credential/CAPTCHA or new physical-device acceptance is claimed.
Target changes invalidate continuations without forcibly interrupting ZIP/XML work already underway. Active uploads still block context changes.
Browser artifacts retain full records/captures for seven days; production-verification retention is 30 days. Dated CSS/controller fixtures, hashes and pinned CI runtime support reproduction.
